Cases with measured ROI

Two cases with closed numbers in real currency — not estimates, not projections. What went into media and what came out as revenue.

Legal ROI +26x

Dr. Felipe Vilela

Positioning + Social + Traffic + CRM

The challenge: a specialist lawyer with excellent technical reputation, but without a predictable acquisition process. Captation relied on referrals — good in quality, poor in scale.

The solution: personal brand repositioning, editorial line focused on legal education, paid traffic campaigns segmented by client profile and CRM to structure closing. SPIN Selling in the sales process.

What Makewell did differently: we treated the marketing operation as a commercial arm. Each lead qualified with clear intent before reaching the firm's team.

Healthcare ROI +20x

Dra. Thielen

Positioning + Social + Traffic

The challenge: a vascular surgeon with technical authority in a highly competitive region. Private schedule with fluctuations and rising media costs in the specialty.

The solution: application of the Medical Funnel — education at the top, authority in the middle, clear offer at the bottom, retention post-consultation. Content production focused on real private patient objections (price, trust, pain).

What Makewell did differently: niche-specific language, high-standard audiovisual production inside the clinic, precise paid media segmentation for the socioeconomic profile.

Cases in the United States

Brazilian-owned businesses in Florida growing with integrated digital marketing.

Home Remodeling · Jacksonville, FL US Market

Nagy Custom Remodeling

Branding + Website + Digital Presence

A Brazilian-owned remodeling contractor in Jacksonville, FL — kitchen, bathroom, flooring and whole-home renovations. Makewell built the brand's digital presence from the ground up: professional website, local SEO strategy and visual identity aligned with the US market.

The challenge: a skilled contractor with a strong reputation built through word of mouth, but no structured digital presence to reach American clients at scale in Jacksonville's competitive remodeling market.

The solution: brand positioning, professional website, local SEO and a bilingual content strategy tailored to the American remodeling market.

What Makewell did: end-to-end brand build — positioning, website, local SEO and content strategy tailored to the Jacksonville market. All bilingual, bridging the Brazilian work ethic with US client expectations.
